title: Law to teach New Yorkers about crypto scams
summary: This bill would require the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection to create an ongoing outreach and education program about deceptive and unconscionable trade practices involving cryptocurrency and other digital assets. It would include tailored programs for the general public, young people, seniors, and immigrants, covering common scams, detection strategies, reporting procedures and legal protections. Materials would be produced in English and the city's designated languages, focused each October, and updated annually, with the law taking effect 120 days after enactment.
